Plan mode.d: A Claude Code permission mode in which Claude can read and investigate but cannot edit files until you approve its proposed plan.

Auto mode.d: A Claude Code permission mode in which Claude acts without routine prompts while a background classifier reviews each action and refuses risky ones. The default for interactive sessions since version 2.1.283.

Classifier.d: An automatic checker that sorts inputs into categories, for example 'safe' or 'risky'. Claude Code's auto mode uses one to review actions before they run.

Checkpoint.d: A saved snapshot of the files Claude Code's edit tools changed during a turn, which you can return to with /rewind. Changes made by shell commands are not included.

Compaction.d: Replacing a long conversation with a shorter summary to free space in the context window, either automatically or with /compact.

Effort level.d: How much reasoning a Claude model does before acting, from low to max. Higher effort is slower and uses more allowance but helps on hard problems.

Session.d: One saved Claude Code conversation, stored on your computer so you can resume, rename, branch or delete it later.

Worktree.d: A separate working copy of a Git repository on its own branch, letting you work on two things at once without them interfering.
